facts.raw_span: A 36-year-old G5P2+2 woman
two prior cesarean deliveries and two first-trimester miscarriages
serum quantitative β-hCG was 16,124 mIU/mL
A transabdominal ultrasound at presentation did not locate an intrauterine or extrauterine pregnancy
A copper intrauterine device had been removed 2 months before her last menstrual period
She had used one cycle of clomiphene
blood pressure was 113/70 mmHg
pulse 98 beats/min
temperature 37.5 °C
Transvaginal ultrasound showed a 13 mm gestational sac with irregular margins and a yolk sac in the anterior isthmic portion of the uterus
Serial β-hCG measurements rose by 33% over 48 hours
a fetal pole with cardiac activity (crown–rump length 0.9 cm) in a sac traversing the full width of the anterior myometrium
